doc: Use of antibiotics in the outpatient management of children 6-59 months of age with severe acute malnutrition

entries.claim: 6-59个月无并发症的严重急性营养不良患儿在门诊管理时应给予口服抗生素（如阿莫西林）治疗。
entries.source_doc: Use of antibiotics in the outpatient management of children 6-59 months of age with severe acute malnutrition

entries.claim: 6-59个月营养不良但非严重急性营养不良的患儿不应常规使用抗生素，除非出现临床感染征象。
entries.source_doc: Use of antibiotics in the outpatient management of children 6-59 months of age with severe acute malnutrition
